newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firms with sellers scarce.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firms with sellers scarce.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat was firm again on Buenos Aires Cereals exchange with exporters and millers finding supplies short and sellers thin on the ground, dealers said.

Cash maize prices were weak in thin trade and new maize was little changed. Soybean prices were steady as crushers and exporters competed on the market. Sunseed prices were pushed up by strong crusher and export demand from few sellers.
